|", "benchmark_context": "# South African IT Sector Holding Company Benchmarking

The IT sector in South Africa is characterized by a mix of massive, legacy systems integrators and highly specialized, agile holding groups. Earnings are forecast to grow at approximately 7.4% annually for the sector [cite: 31].

### 2.1 Overhead Ratios in IT Holding Groups
Overhead ratios in South African IT holding companies typically range from 15% to 35% of total revenue [cite: 32].
